Market today:
The mood is clearly cautious, driven by worsening inflation and the expectation of Fed rate hikes. This is a major headwind for your tech and chip names, especially those on margin, as higher rates make growth stocks less attractive and borrowing more expensive.

Your holdings:
Your portfolio is almost entirely flagged "SELL" or "TRIM," with deep losses in leveraged tech/chip ETFs like SOXL (-88.6%), MUU (-78.1%), and SMCI (-50.89%). Margin amplifies these drops, making risk management critical.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on inflation data and any Fed commentary. Also, monitor news around data center investments, as potential moratoriums could further impact chip demand.

Bottom line:
Focus on aggressive risk management and protecting capital in this challenging environment for your concentrated tech book.
plays: Respect stops on your leveraged bull positions like SOXL and MUU; their deep losses and "SELL" status demand immediate attention.
Consider trimming other "SELL" status tech/chip holdings to reduce overall margin exposure and concentration risk.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
